slot.instructions: Which words of the transcript are the thing the command carries verbatim: the address to open, the search terms, the song to play, the text to type, the key to press? Never the command word itself: "play X" carries X. A line with no command word, such as a question, carries itself: its search terms are the line as asked. Choose none when it carries none.

options.none: the command carries no words of its own

amount.instructions: Only when the action skips forward or back in a video or audio, changes its volume or speed, or changes an app number (a setting's amount, the panel's width): how far? For a skip, choose words when the words say how far — a number of seconds, or of minutes; otherwise the share of its length the words mean. For a volume, a speed or an app number, choose to when the words carry the level, else up or down and how far. Ignored for every other action.

options.words: as far as the words say: the number they carry, in seconds, or in minutes when they say minutes
options.moment: a moment: a hundredth of its length
options.little: a little: a twentieth of its length
options.chunk: a chunk: a tenth of its length
options.lot: a lot: a quarter of its length
options.end: all the way: to the end, or back to the start
options.to: the volume, speed or app number to the number the words carry
options.up-little: the volume, speed or app number up a little
options.up-step: the volume, speed or app number up a step
options.up-lot: the volume, speed or app number up a lot
options.up-all: the volume, speed or app number up as far as it goes
options.down-little: the volume, speed or app number down a little
options.down-step: the volume, speed or app number down a step
options.down-lot: the volume, speed or app number down a lot
options.down-all: the volume, speed or app number down as far as it goes
